punchline: Ann Trason led at the fifty-mile turnaround, but Juan Herrera passed her with a half marathon left and won Leadville.
thirty_sec: In August 1994, Ann Trason lined up at the Leadville 100 beside seven Tarahumara runners. She pulled ahead on Hope Pass and reached the fifty-mile turnaround first, in under nine hours. Juan Herrera kept gaining, closed to a few minutes by Turquoise Lake, and passed her with a half marathon left. He won in 17:30, a course record then. She was second in 18:06.
